cohort: Pregnant women with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection in the Netherlands
finding: Pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection in the Netherlands had an increased risk of hospital admission, intensive care admission, and cesarean section, particularly if they were of non-European origin or overweight/obese.
mod_finding: Cesarean section after labor-onset was increased in pregnant women with SARS-CoV-2 infection (OR 1.58, 95% CI 1.09-2.28).
